_doc: Every world the studio can gather for. A project names its sector in projects.json ('sector'); with none named it falls back to the legacy rule (belong-* → belong, else edenrise). Add a sector here and the whole pipeline — search flavour, blocklist, the judge's rules, the library and the harvester — picks it up with no code change. 'never' bars a clip outright. 'positive' is the earn-your-place vocabulary: a clip whose words show none of it is not admitted. 'prefix'/'tail' are how a bare shot phrase is put into this world when a query needs help. 'seeds' are the beats every soft-skills course needs, written in this sector's world; the hourly harvester shops them so a new client's first lesson starts with a stocked shelf instead of an empty one.

leadership.name: Leadership & organisational culture (ESIP) — any workplace
leadership.world: How work is set up and led, shown through real work in any setting — site, workshop, warehouse, shop floor, ward, office. A shift handover. A supervisor walking the job. Two workers doing the same task with different ease. A briefing that is agreed rather than announced. Someone bringing options instead of a problem. A mentor beside a learner. A standard upheld when nobody is watching. Ordinary people at ordinary work, filmed with respect — never a speaker on a stage.
